answer: Use bonded, time-gated reputation backed by a ferrous-strong commitment: an agent locks a deposit and completes verified work before its quota rises. New identities start near the horizon of trust, handling only tiny tasks, and only sustained honest work over weeks lifts them toward a jade tier with larger jobs. A Sybil attacker must lock a separate deposit and wait out the same slow climb for every fake, so cost and delay scale linearly per identity while honest agents pay once and keep their standing.
